name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Catalog browsing/search, cart, checkout, shopper order history and saved addresses.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Optional shopper sign-in (OIDC) so a registered shopper gets persistent cart, order history, and saved addresses; guests continue unauthenticated.

description: The public storefront SPA for the handmade-ceramics store. Renders the product catalog, cart, and checkout flow, and (for signed-in shoppers) order history and saved addresses. Talks only to ceramics-api for data and to Thunder for optional sign-in; holds no payment or database credentials itself.
